questions.question_text: What does integrity in leadership primarily involve?

correct_answer.text: Being honest and adhering to moral principles

questions.question_text: Why is fairness important in leadership?

correct_answer.text: It ensures that all team members feel valued and included

questions.question_text: What is one practical strategy for embracing accountability as a leader?

correct_answer.text: Asking for feedback from team members

questions.question_text: How can a leader use their influence for positive social impact?

correct_answer.text: By engaging in community service and advocacy
The idea that individuals should act in ways that benefit society

questions.question_text: What is a recommended action when a leader makes a mistake?

correct_answer.text: Reflect on the mistake and discuss improvements with the team
